candidate_program.name: capped_capture_envelope
candidate_program.rationale: Takes the larger count-efficiency or weighted-capture estimate, capped at twenty percent above count efficiency. Reach is local count and conflict mass; min/max arithmetic is fixed and summary maintenance remains charged, while optimistic capture can overvalue overlapping alternatives.
candidate_program.rule: min(1.2 * weight / (1 + degree), max(weight / (1 + degree), weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
